actions-list.actionItem: The Speaker announced that the House do now adjourn pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I. The next meeting is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. on September 24, 2026.

The House received a message from the Clerk. Pursuant to the permission granted in Clause 2(h) of Rule II of the Rules of the U.S. House of Representatives, the Clerk notified the House that he had received the following message from the Secretary of the Senate on September 18, 2026, at 10:15 a.m.: That the Senate passed H.R. 5345. Appointments: Board of Visitors of the U.S. Naval Academy; Public Safety Officer Medal of Valor Review Board.

The Chair informed the House that, pursuant to House Resolution 1543, the Speaker has certified to the United States Attorney for the District of Columbia the refusal of Leon D. Black to produce documents to and appear for a deposition before the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform as directed by subpoena.
The Chair led the House in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.
Pursuant to clause 13 of Rule I, the Journal of the last day's proceedings was approved.
Today's prayer was offered by the House Chaplain, Chaplain Margaret Grun Kibben.
The Speaker designated the Honorable Michael K. Simpson to act as Speaker pro tempore for today.
The House convened, starting a new legislative day.
